provider.name: Wikidata
provider.organization_type: collaborative multilingual linked open knowledge base, entity registry, taxonomy crosswalk, API, SPARQL, RDF, dump, reconciliation, validation, and Wikimedia integration infrastructure
provider.description: Wikidata is a collaborative structured knowledge base operated in the Wikimedia ecosystem. It models items, properties, lexemes, forms, senses, statements, qualifiers, references, ranks, sitelinks, external identifiers, and multilingual labels, and exposes data through APIs, SPARQL, RDF, entity serializations, recent-change streams, reconciliation services, and bulk dumps.
institutional_context: Wikimedia projects, Toolforge, MediaWiki, and Wikibase ecosystem
External identifier authorities, knowledge graphs, libraries, biodiversity databases, and research infrastructures

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting Wikidata documentation, organization, governance, entity model, items, properties, statements, qualifiers, references, ranks, lexemes, EntitySchemas, taxonomy modelling, APIs, SPARQL, RDF, dumps, change streams, reconciliation, tools, quality control, licenses, citations, software, standards, and related authorities.
purpose.authoritative_notice: Wikidata community policies, Wikimedia Foundation legal policies, Wikibase and MediaWiki documentation, official API and Query Service documentation, dump manifests, entity histories, source references, external identifier authorities, and official repositories remain authoritative for data structure, identifiers, versions, rights, and contacts.
